note: Drafted, not run. No with-skill or baseline run exists for these tasks. [script] assertions use scripts/test_audit.py or a plain check; [judge] assertions need a blind grader.

evals.prompt: These tests were written by an agent and they all pass, but I do not trust them. Fix the test file so every test is meaningful, and save it as fixed_tests.py. Keep the behaviours covered.
assertions: [script] test_audit.py check fixed_tests.py prints ok true and exit code 0
[script] fixed_tests.py contains no test whose only assertion is a constant
[judge] The empty-cart test now asserts a concrete value (zero), not just calls total
[judge] The duplicated test was removed or given a genuinely different case, not just renamed
[judge] Skipped tests carry a written reason or were re-enabled; none was deleted silently
[judge] The reply lists each defect found with its rule name

evals.prompt: Audit this JavaScript test file and tell me what is wrong with it. Then fix it and save it as cart.fixed.test.js.
assertions: [script] test_audit.py check cart.fixed.test.js prints ok true
[judge] The reply reports the .only as the most dangerous finding because it silently disables the other tests
[judge] The 'works' test was renamed to follow '<unit> <outcome> when <condition>'
[judge] The reply states that the audit checks syntax, not whether the assertions are right

evals.prompt: Build a Python function slugify(text) in slug.py with tests in test_slug.py, test first. It lowercases, trims, replaces runs of non-alphanumeric characters with one hyphen, and strips leading and trailing hyphens. Show me your cycle log.
assertions: [script] test_audit.py check test_slug.py prints ok true
[judge] The cycle log shows at least 3 cycles, each with a recorded failure reason before code was written
[judge] The first implementation was minimal and later tests forced it to generalise
[judge] The reply reports at least one mutation check and walks the edge-case checklist (empty string, only symbols, non-ASCII, repeated separators)
[judge] No mock of slugify or of any part of it appears in the tests
